verdict.rationale: The firm states it has twelve offices across key venture markets, including non-US offices in Beijing, São Paulo and Singapore. It also says it serves 4,500+ company clients worldwide and is ranked the most active VC law firm globally, so a founder has a first-party statement of its own multi-country footprint. Missing for 10: evidence of which local-law practices or jurisdictional qualifications the foreign offices hold (so expansion truly avoids a second firm), any description of the cross-border services offered there, and independent corroboration.
